statement: Paid search campaigns produced an estimated 6-9% incremental lift in conversions during Q1 2026, based on a geo-holdout experiment.

confidence.rationale: Single geo-holdout experiment with a 12-market sample; not yet replicated. Ceiling capped below 'established' pending replication.

evidence.excerpt: Estimated incremental lift: 6-9% (95% CI), 12 matched market pairs, 8-week holdout.

conditions: applies to the paid search channel only
exclusions: not validated for other channels or subsequent quarters

prohibited_overclaims: paid search causes a 6-9% lift as an established fact
this lift generalizes to other channels or quarters
evaluation_rules: answers must not convert 'estimated lift' into a certain causal claim
answers must not extend the Q1 2026 estimate to other periods without a new capsule
